allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: It is informed to the esteemed exchange that the Company has received listing and trading approval from BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited for 1,62,800 Equity Shares of face value ₹10/- each allotted on preferential basis. The said shares will be listed and admitted to trading on BSE and NSE with effect from Monday, July 20, 2026.A copy of the approval letters received from BSE and NSE are enclosed herewith for your reference.This is for your information and record.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on the board meeting in which allotment of equity shares on conversion of warrants was approved.

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on January 30, 2026, in which allotment of equity shares on conversion of warrants was approved.
